how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-zephras-isle-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:92460:title: Coming of Age
rows.quest:92460:desc:0: Look at you, bright eyed and ready for adventure! We need all the help we can get here in Thendal Village and your arrival is most welcome. I imagine you are brimming with nerves for what is to come. After all, you only get to come of age once in a lifetime. ...
rows.quest:92460:obj:0: Speak with Rorian the Dayseeker in Thendal Grove.
rows.quest:92460:details:0: Look at you, bright eyed and ready for adventure! We've been awaiting your arrival and anticipating your much needed help here in Thendal Village. I imagine you are brimming with both nerves and excitement for what is to come. After all, you only get to come of age once in a lifetime.
rows.quest:92460:details:1: Go, seek out our village leader Rorian the Dayseeker at the entrance to the greatfather tree just west of here. He will get you started on your journey.
rows.quest:92461:title: Harmony in ⟦E1⟧
rows.quest:92461:desc:0: We live in times of great uncertainty for our people. We face unprecedented challenges that may require bold solutions, but we also must contend with the ordinary and mundane here in Thendal Grove. Take, for example, the recent unsustainable rise in the vuldren population. ...
rows.quest:92461:obj:0: Slay 8 Vuldren Juveniles in Thendal Grove.
rows.quest:92461:details:0: We live in times of great uncertainty for our people. We face unprecedented challenges that may require bold solutions, but we also must contend with the ordinary and mundane here in Thendal Grove. Take, for example, the recent unsustainable rise in the vuldren population.
rows.quest:92461:details:1: The vuldren are a vital part of our ecosystem. However, imbalances must be corrected to maintain the delicate harmony that all creatures in Thendal Grove share.
rows.quest:92461:details:2: ⟦E2⟧ east and cull some of the vuldren there.
rows.quest:92461:progress:0: As unsavory as it is to need to cull living creatures, this type of guiding hand is needed to avert disaster in our homeland. This is an important lesson for one such as yourself to learn.
rows.quest:92462:title: Infestation Investigation
rows.quest:92462:desc:0:
One of our rangers recently reported an infestation of cirrusflies here in Thendal Grove.
Cirrusflies can be dangerous if the ⟦E3⟧ is allowed to grow too large, so please head to the eastern end of the Grove and exterminate as many as you can.
rows.quest:92462:obj:0: Slay 8 Pesky Cirrusflies in Thendal Grove.
rows.quest:92462:details:0: One of our rangers recently reported an infestation of cirrusflies here in Thendal Grove.
rows.quest:92462:details:1: Cirrusflies can be dangerous if the ⟦E3⟧ is allowed to grow too large, so please head to the eastern end of the Grove and exterminate as many as you can.
rows.quest:92462:progress:0: Such pests cannot be allowed to find ⟦E4⟧ in our peaceful grove. An infestation can quickly grow dangerous if left unchecked.
rows.quest:92474:title: Falling With Style
rows.quest:92474:desc:0:
Well hello there, adventurer! Want to play a game?
All you've got to do is step up on that ledge... then jump! ⟦E5⟧ your innate ⟦E6⟧ to walk on the air to slow your fall and see how far forward you can float. ...
rows.quest:92474:obj:0: Jump from the top of the watchtower in Thendal Grove and use your Walk on Air ⟦E6⟧ to slow your fall.
rows.quest:92474:details:0: Well hello there, ! Want to play a game?
rows.quest:92474:details:1: All you've got to do is step up on that ledge... then jump! ⟦E5⟧ your innate ⟦E6⟧ to walk on the air to slow your fall and see how far forward you can float.
rows.quest:92474:details:2: The rules are made up and the ⟦E7⟧ don't matter, but you get bonus ⟦E7⟧ if you can land right in front of Rorian the Dayseeker and startle him! He won't like it but I'll certainly get a good laugh if you can get him all worked up! Hah!
rows.quest:92474:progress:0: Using your ⟦E6⟧ to walk on air can get you out of--and, well... into--all kinds of trouble!
rows.quest:92481:title: A Student of the ⟦E8⟧
rows.quest:92481:desc:0: While you were away dealing with our vuldren problem, our resident mage ⟦E9⟧--Dorii Brightwhisper--left this recall crystal for you. It contains some sort of message for you, so give it a look. Afterwards, you can find Dorii in the structure just behind me.
rows.quest:92481:obj:0: Examine the ⟦E10⟧, then speak with Dorii Brightwhisper in Thendal Grove.
rows.quest:92481:details:0: While you were away dealing with our vuldren problem, our resident mage ⟦E9⟧--Dorii Brightwhisper--left this recall crystal for you. It contains some sort of message for you, so give it a look. Afterwards, you can find Dorii in the structure just behind me.
rows.quest:92481:progress:0: Greetings, ⟦1⟧. I'm pleased to have the privilege of furthering your magical studies.
rows.quest:92482:title: The Way of the ⟦E11⟧
rows.quest:92482:obj:0: Read the ⟦E12⟧ and then speak with Tai'ree Farsight in Thendal Grove.
rows.quest:92482:details:0: While you were away dealing with our vuldren problem, our resident hunter ⟦E9⟧--Tai'ree Farsight--left this note for you. You can find her just over yonder near the center of the village. Read the note then seek her out.
rows.quest:92483:title: At Home in the Shadows
rows.quest:92483:obj:0: Read the ⟦E13⟧ then speak with Akeri Duskblade within the watchtower in Thendal Grove.
rows.quest:92483:details:0: While you were away dealing with our vuldren problem, our resident rogue ⟦E9⟧--Akeri Duskblade--has requested to speak with you. He left this note, so read that first, then seek him out inside the watchtower, here in the village.
rows.quest:92483:details:1: He's a shady fellow, but then again, so are you. I think you'll get along well.
rows.quest:94414:title: The Anchors of Zephras
rows.quest:94414:desc:0:
Greetings, young adventurer. I oftentimes come here to look upon the ancient anchor pylon. Gifts from the spirits of the winds, they bind and sustain our island. Of late however, their magic has grown unstable and inconsistent.
They suffer no distress I can see. Their splendor has not changed. ...
rows.quest:94414:obj:0: Speak with Halaan Hawk-Eye and borrow his gift to view the anchor pylon in the distance.
rows.quest:94414:details:0: Greetings, young . I often times come here to look upon the ancient anchor pylon. Gifts from the spirits of the winds, they bind and sustain our island. Of late however, their magic has grown unstable and inconsistent.
rows.quest:94414:details:1: They suffer no distress I can see. Their splendor has not changed.
rows.quest:94414:details:2: If you'd like, I can lend you my gift to look upon them yourself.
rows.quest:94414:progress:0: My gift is simple, and mundane. I cannot peer between worlds such as those with the skysight, nor can I draw upon the magic of the ley lines beneath Zephras like others can. But a gift it remains and I am grateful to have it.
rows.quest:94414:progress:1: Appreciation of what you have is the key to happiness. Yearning for what you may have, or what you have lost, only leads to despair.
rows.quest:92463:title: The Cirrusfly Queen
rows.quest:92463:obj:0: Destroy the Cirrusfly Queen in Thendal Grove.
rows.quest:92463:details:0: If the forest is as thick with these insects as it sounds, simply killing the workers won't be enough.
rows.quest:92463:details:1: Go deeper into the forest and find the queen. She'll be close to the hive and surrounded by bigger and more aggressive soldiers, so be careful.
rows.quest:92463:details:2: Put her down and return here when it's done. That'll be one less problem to think about around here.
rows.quest:92463:progress:0: Cirrusflies aren't to be underestimated. They might not seem dangerous, but you have to watch out for the bigger ones. The bigger they are, the meaner!
rows.quest:92464:title: ⟦E15⟧ Unrest
rows.quest:92464:desc:0: Ever since our elemental benefactors left us, it seems that we are simply moving from one unrest to another. The problem we face now is that the manifestations of the winds near the standing stones to the northeast are agitated. ...
rows.quest:92464:obj:0: Speak to the Yala Windwatcher in Thendal Grove.
rows.quest:92464:details:0: Ever since our elemental benefactors left us, it seems that we are simply moving from one unrest to another. The problem we face now is that the manifestations of the winds near the standing stones to the northeast are agitated.
rows.quest:92464:details:1: Not truly self-aware like the sentient wind spirits that once lived here, these simple sprites respond in kind to forces, emotions, and intentions of the creatures around them.
rows.quest:92464:details:2: My apprentice Yala Windwatcher went to observe them. Seek her out and discover what she's learned.
rows.quest:92465:title: Agitators
rows.quest:92465:desc:0:
The Al'Aketh cult is a blight upon this island. These cultists are surely the ones responsible for agitating the simple wind sprites that reside here and turning them violent.
Regrettably, we'll need to disperse these roiling winds here before they harm someone. ...
rows.quest:92465:obj:0: Slay 6 Roiling Winds and 7 Al'Aketh Converts in Thendal Grove.
rows.quest:92465:details:0: The Al'Aketh cult is a blight upon this island. These cultists are surely the ones responsible for agitating the simple wind sprites that reside here and turning them violent.
rows.quest:92465:details:1: Regrettably, we'll need to disperse these roiling winds here before they harm someone. We also need to send a clear message to the cult that they are not welcome in the grove.
rows.quest:92465:details:2: Will you lend me your aid, ?
rows.quest:92469:title: Return to Rorian
rows.quest:92469:obj:0: Bring word of the Al'Aketh to Rorian the Dayseeker in Thendal Grove.
rows.quest:92469:details:0: You've done enough here, . I'll stay and clean up any stragglers down there.
rows.quest:92469:details:1: ⟦E2⟧ back to the Village and tell Rorian about the cult's presence. He will not be pleased.
rows.quest:92471:title: Aetheen of the Gales
rows.quest:92471:obj:0: Speak with Aetheen of the Gales in Thendal Grove.
rows.quest:92471:details:0: You may not realize this but everything you've done has been a trial of sorts. A test for what is to come for you. It's a big island out there, and Zephras needs spirited young adventurers such as yourself if we are to survive the trials our people face.
rows.quest:92471:details:1: The one called Aetheen of the Gales is one of the leaders of our people here on ⟦E14⟧, and she has been watching you. She has a task that you must complete. Speak with her to learn more.
rows.quest:92473:title: Aggressive ⟦E16⟧
rows.quest:92473:obj:0: Collect 6 Scrawny Ursera Claws from Scrawny Ursera in Thendal Grove.
rows.quest:92473:details:0: The ursera den to the southwest is rapidly becoming a problem. Just last week the rangers had to kill an adolescent ursera who wandered too close to the village and attempted to attack a boy playing near the base of the elder tree in the center of the village.
rows.quest:92473:details:1: We were fortunate that the boy escaped with his life. Hunger and desperation makes these beasts too dangerous to be left unchecked. Go south and put the scrawniest among the ursera down. Bring me their claws as proof when it is done.
rows.quest:92473:progress:0: The ursera have grown far more aggressive of late. I wonder what has changed to cause this shift in behavior?
rows.quest:92597:title: Reading the Ley Lines
rows.quest:92597:desc:0: Here in the elemental plane, we derive much of our arcane strength from ley lines that still run through the ground under our feet. Of late, these ley lines have begun to pierce the surface, giving us more direct and powerful access to these latent arcane energies. ...
rows.quest:92597:obj:0: ⟦E5⟧ your Read Ley Line racial ⟦E6⟧ at the ley line in Thendal Grove.
rows.quest:92597:obj:1: * ⟦E5⟧ your Read Ley Line ⟦E6⟧ near the Thendral Grove Ley Line
rows.quest:92597:details:0: Here in the elemental plane, we derive much of our arcane strength from ley lines that still run through the ground under our feet. Of late, these ley lines have begun to pierce the surface, giving us more direct and powerful access to these latent arcane energies.
rows.quest:92597:details:1: Go to the standing stones to the northeast. There is a ley line there. Tap into your birthright and draw in its energy.
rows.quest:92597:progress:0: Realizing our true potential as sons and daughters of the highborne is our only path to ⟦E18⟧. The Windshapers are little better than the Al'Aketh, supplicating themselves to uncaring, otherworldly creatures.
rows.quest:92598:title: The Gift of Skysight
rows.quest:92598:obj:0: ⟦E5⟧ your Skysight racial ⟦E6⟧ at the ⟦E15⟧ Convergence in Thendal Grove.
rows.quest:92598:details:0: As a Windshaper, you have the ⟦E6⟧ to use the sacred skysight gifted to us by the ⟦E19⟧. ⟦E20⟧ to the standing stones to the northeast of the village. Find the elemental convergence there and use your gift.
rows.quest:92598:details:1: You'll find that you may draw upon the skysight anywhere, but its boon is much more powerful if you do so in the presence of an elemental convergence. You may at times receive other bits of wisdom from the spirits that are drawn to such places of power, as well.
rows.quest:92598:progress:0: The gift of skysight will provide you a powerful boon. ⟦E5⟧ it wisely.
rows.quest:93552:title: Harvesting Windstones
rows.quest:93552:desc:0: Windstones are a critical resource on ⟦E14⟧ as they contain the raw, concentrated energy of the winds themselves. The wind elementals who used to live here on Zephras with us vanished a number of years ago, and since then, the magic that sustains this island is slowly fading. ...
rows.quest:93552:obj:0: Collect 15 ⟦E21⟧ Clusters from Raw Windstones in Thendal Grove.
rows.quest:93552:details:0: Windstones are a critical resource on ⟦E14⟧ as they contain the raw, concentrated energy of the winds themselves. The wind elementals who used to live here on zephras with us vanished several centuries ago, and since then, the magic that sustains this island is slowly fading. Not without limitations, the Windstones are still a reliable energy source, and are incredibly valuable to us.
rows.quest:93552:details:1: You'll find raw Windstones scattered around the grove, think you can help me harvest them?
rows.quest:92470:title: Foul Matriarch
rows.quest:92470:obj:0: Slay 8 Ursera Scavengers and collect the head of the den mother, Urs'anah in Thendal Grove.
rows.quest:92470:details:0: Rorian informed you that I've been watching you. I now offer you a test of resolve. However, be warned--it will send you into great danger.
rows.quest:92470:details:1: Go to the caves to the south. Thin out the ursera's numbers there, and find their matriarch, one the rangers call "Urs'anah". Put her down and bring me proof of her demise. Once you have done that, you will have taken an important step on your path.
rows.quest:92470:progress:0: What I ask of you is not easy, but you must be prepared for much greater challenges if you are to survive long enough to be of service to ⟦E14⟧.
rows.quest:92472:title: The Next Step
rows.quest:92472:obj:0: Report to Constable Aonda in Shen'dar Village.
rows.quest:92472:details:0: One of the most pervasive threats on ⟦E14⟧ is the Al'Aketh Cult. They are religious zealots devoted to the worship of the supposed elemental ruler of Skywall, Al'Akir the Windlord. They are brutal, single minded, and their power and ambitions are growing more deadly by the day.
rows.quest:92472:details:1: Your path will soon take you to Shen'dar Village to the south. Present yourself to Constable Aonda when you arrive. The cult threatens Shen'dar and they are in need of aid. Tell Aonda that I sent you.
rows.quest:92544:title: Al'Aketh Thugs
rows.quest:92544:obj:0: Slay 6 Al'Aketh Brutes, 4 Al'Aketh Neophytes, and Malduko Cloudcrush in Thendal Grove.
rows.quest:92544:details:0: A band of Al'Aketh cult ruffians have taken up residence near the temple ruins just southwest of here, led by a real monster called Malduko Cloudcrush. This rabble has no doubt been dispatched here by High Priestess Lorthuna at the Shrine of Akir to attack travelers and coerce our people into joining the cult.
rows.quest:92544:details:1: I need to stay here at my post to alert travelers leaving the grove of the danger, but I would be grateful if you could do something about those cultists and their leader for me.
rows.quest:92544:progress:0: I suspect that seeing a few of their fellows bleeding on the ground will do wonders to dissuade any zealous ambitions these thugs might have had.
rows.quest:92544:completion:0: It was all I could do to stop myself from going over and joining you from my position here. I can only hope that these louts got the message and clear out of here soon.
rows.quest:92544:completion:1: Thank you, ⟦3⟧. You have the gratitude of the Rangers of Thendal Grove.
rows.quest:92514:title: Welcome to Shen'dar Village
rows.quest:92514:obj:0: Speak with Illaya Amberwind and Coriella Calmbreeze in Shen'dar Village.
rows.quest:92515:title: The Problem With Prideclaws
rows.quest:92515:desc:0: As if bandits and mad cultists weren't enough, the hills are thick with prideclaws as well right now. They are starting to encroach on the village borders and growing bolder by the day. It's only a matter of time before someone's ⟦E24⟧ or child is taken. ...
rows.quest:92515:obj:0: Collect 10 Prideclaw Pelts from the Prideclaws in Shen'dar Highlands.
rows.quest:92515:details:0: As if bandits and mad cultists weren't enough, the hills are thick with prideclaws as well right now. They are starting to encroach on the village borders and growing bolder by the day. It's only a matter of time before someone's ⟦E24⟧ or child is taken. ...
rows.quest:92553:title: Restocking the Larders
rows.quest:92553:desc:0: Up for a bit of work? I could use a bit of muscle from a strong adventuring-type such as yourself. With how dangerous things are getting around here, no one's had much time to hunt or forage of late, and I need someone to get out there and source me fresh eggs and strider meat to keep this village ...
rows.quest:92553:obj:0: Collect 3 Small Eggs and 8 ⟦E25⟧ from creatures found throughout the Shen'dar Highlands.
rows.quest:92553:details:0: Up for a bit of work? I could use a bit of muscle from a strong adventuring-type such as yourself. With how dangerous things are getting around here, no one's had much time to hunt or forage of late, and I need someone to get out there and source me fresh eggs and strider meat to keep this village ...
rows.quest:92595:title: The Windshapers
rows.quest:92595:obj:0: Listen to what Illaya Amberwind has to say.
rows.quest:92596:title: The High Order
rows.quest:92596:obj:0: Have a seat and speak with Rathiril Sunlance.
rows.quest:93461:title: Welcome to Shen'dar Village
rows.quest:93461:obj:0: Speak with Rathiril Sunlance and Coriella Calmbreeze in Shen'dar Village.
rows.quest:94411:title: Meddlesome Mages
rows.quest:94411:desc:0: Be warned, members of the High Order have been seen in the vicinity of the standing stones north of the village. We have warned them time and again to not meddle at our sacred sites, but they are growing more bold in pushing us. ...
rows.quest:94411:obj:0: Slay 6 High Order Apprentices in Shen'dar Highlands.
rows.quest:94411:details:0: Be warned, members of the High Order have been seen in the vicinity of the standing stones north of the village. We have warned them time and again to not meddle at our sacred sites, but they are growing more bold in pushing us. ...
rows.quest:94413:title: A Magical Affront
rows.quest:94413:obj:0: Slay 6 Windshaper Novice Seers in Shen'dar Highlands.
rows.quest:96101:title: The Great Outdoors
rows.quest:96101:obj:0: Sit near Raan's Basic Campfire and wait until you receive the Boosted Rest buff.
rows.quest:96638:title: The Adventurer
rows.quest:96638:obj:0: Speak to Raan Wildwind near Shen'dar Village.
rows.quest:96638:details:0: More and more adventurers like yourself have been seeking glory and fortune outside of the safety of Thendal Grove. There's one such adventurer who has made a camp outside of Shen'dar Village, along the road leading southwest out of Thendal Grove.
rows.quest:96638:details:1: Seek him out and see what you can learn from him that may help you in your own travels.
